planItem: 77.44.7.A — Inspector content property validation and Save/Publish lifecycle
finding: Authored content controls shared one live validation message, but the message had no DOM id. Controls and the media picker used its empty id in aria-describedby, leaving screen-reader descriptions without a valid target.
change: Give the shared validation message a unique stable-per-render id and associate authored content inputs with it through aria-describedby. The existing invalid-state handling and command validation remain unchanged.

newAssertions: content.href aria-describedby resolves to exactly one Inspector validation element
unsafe javascript URL sets aria-invalid and displays associated validation feedback
existing link edit, undo/redo, Save, reload and separate Publish lifecycle still passes

openSourceReview: Used the repository's existing shared content-field validation and accessibility patterns; no external package or copied code was needed.
acceptanceBoundary: This closes the described validation association defect for authored content controls only. Full 77.44.7.A remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED; manual and physical acceptance remains deferred until the complete Visual Editor is implemented.
